info.title: Priors API
info.description:
Maps the third-party sources an AI engine retrieves for a category, audits how a brand is described in each, and ranks off-site actions by leverage.

**To try authenticated routes:** call `POST /auth/login`, copy `access_token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: A workspace is a tenant. Everything a client owns lives under one.

tags.name: Brands
tags.description: The brand whose standing is audited. `fact_sheet` is the ground truth used to detect stale descriptions.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: A product category to map, tied to one brand in the same workspace.

tags.name: Queries
tags.description: The conversational prompts a category is measured with. Generated by the LLM in groups of paraphrases, or added by hand.

tags.name: Harvests
tags.description: A run asks Gemini every active query several times with Google Search grounding and records which pages each answer was built from.

tags.name: Influence
tags.description: Which sources a completed run's answers were built from, ranked by influence, and which get cited together.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Fetching and caching the pages a run cites, so their text can be audited.

tags.name: Standings
tags.description: How each top source describes the brand: stance, staleness against the fact sheet, and a verbatim quote as evidence.

tags.name: Leverage
tags.description: The ranked action list (influence x deficit) and the run's headline numbers.

tags.name: Shifts
tags.description: Week-over-week changes: sources entering or leaving the answers, citation rate moves, and pages whose verdict changed. Runs weekly for categories with weekly_harvest on.

domains.description: Sites the brand owns. Cited pages on them (and their subdomains) are labelled owned and not audited as third-party sources. URLs and www. are stripped.

fact_sheet.description: Any JSON object, up to 20,000 characters. Current facts used to spot stale mentions.

BrandUpdate.description: Any subset of the brand fields; at least one is required.

brand_id.description: Must be a brand in the same workspace

description.description: Given to the query generator as context
description.example: Software and agencies that help brands get cited and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity

weekly_harvest.description: Re-harvest this category on the weekly schedule (HARVEST_CRON, default Mondays 06:00 UTC). Each run spends LLM quota.

CategoryUpdate.description: Any of name, description, weekly_harvest; brand_id cannot be changed

ShiftEvent.description: A change between a run and the category's previous audited run. Source-level events need the source cited at least 3 times and a 10-point move in citation rate; brand-level rate changes (source_id null, payload.metric set) need 5 points; standing changes have no minimum.

delta.description: Citation rate change for entered/exited/rate events; change in deficit for standing_changed (positive = worse for the brand)

payload.description: Before/after values, and the evidence for standing changes

variant_of.description: The seed query this paraphrases; null for seeds

active.description: Inactive queries are skipped by harvests

group.description: Paraphrases of one underlying need share a group

queries.description: GeneratedQuery items when previewing; saved Query rows when save=true

stats.description: Progress counters while running; full totals once finished

ungrounded_answers.description: Answers Gemini gave without citing any page

new_sources.description: Cited in this run but in no earlier run of the category

unresolved_chunks.description: Grounding links that could not be resolved to a page

fetch.description: Set once the run's top sources have been fetched

new.description: First readable copy of the page

changed.description: Page text differs from the last copy

unchanged.description: Downloaded, but the text hash matched a stored copy

not_modified.description: Server answered 304 to a conditional request

skipped_fresh.description: Checked recently enough that no request was made

needs_audit.description: new + changed: page texts the standing audit has not seen

audit.description: Set once the run's sources have been audited

owned.description: On the brand's own domains; not audited

not_fetched.description: No readable copy of the page

cached.description: Page text already audited under this prompt version; verdict reused

absent_by_rule.description: Brand never named on the page; marked absent without the LLM

evidence_rejected.description: LLM's quote was not on the page, twice; no verdict stored

shifts.description: Set once the run has been compared with the category's previous audited run

Headline.description: Set once the run has been audited. Rates are 0-1; null when there is nothing to divide by.

brand_mention_rate.description: Share of answers that name the brand

owned_citation_rate.description: Share of answers grounded in one of the brand's own pages

grounded_answer_rate.description: Share of answers that cited any page

sources.description: Distinct pages cited in the run

top5_concentration.description: Share of all influence held by the 5 most influential pages

owned_influence_share.description: Share of all influence held by the brand's own pages

audit_coverage.description: Share of the top third-party sources' influence that has a verdict

stance_mix.description: Of the audited third-party influence, the share describing the brand each way

stale_share.description: Of the audited influence, the share on pages with stale facts

total_leverage.description: Sum of leverage over audited sources

deficit.description: absent 1.0, unfavorable 0.9, neutral 0.4, favorable 0; at least 0.8 when stale

influence.description: Mean share of grounding support across all of the run's answers (0-1). The ranking key.

citation_rate.description: Share of the run's answers that cited this source

query_count.description: Distinct queries whose answers cited this source

fetch_status.description: State of the page snapshot this run reads; null until the source has been fetched

pages.description: Distinct pages on this site that were cited

citation_rate.description: Share of answers citing any page on this site

brand_mentioned.description: The answer names the brand or one of its aliases

search_queries.description: Google searches Gemini ran to ground the answer

citations.description: Pages the answer was grounded in, heaviest first

support_weight.description: Share of the answer's grounded text this page supports (0-1)

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

NotFound.description: Not found, or belongs to a workspace you are not a member of

Forbidden.description: You are a member of the workspace but lack the required role

What changed in this run since the previous audited one
get.description: Computed automatically after the run's audit. A category's first run has nothing to compare with and has no events.

summary.description: The run's stats.shifts; null until it has been compared

post.summary: Generate a conversational query set with the LLM
post.description: Asks Gemini for groups of paraphrased buyer questions about the category, then drops duplicates (including ones already saved), fragments, and any query naming the brand or its aliases, so measurements stay category-level. With `save: false` (default) nothing is stored, so you can review the set first.

502.description: LLM request failed or returned unusable output

post.description: Queries already in the category are skipped, not rejected.

text.example: how do i get my brand mentioned in chatgpt answers

post.description: Queues a background job that asks Gemini (with Google Search grounding) every active query `samples_per_query` times, resolves the grounding redirect links to real page URLs, and stores each answer with the pages it was grounded in. Calls are paced to stay under the free-tier rate limit, so a 60-query run with 3 samples takes roughly 20-25 minutes. Poll `GET /runs/{runId}` for progress.

400.description: Invalid body, or the category has no active queries

409.description: A harvest is already queued or running for this category

get.summary: Get a harvest with its progress and stats
List a harvest's answers with their citations

get.description: Influence is computed when a run completes: each source's summed support weight divided by all answers in the run, including answers Gemini gave without citing anything. `group_by=domain` rolls pages up by site.

200.description: Ranked sources (SourceInfluence items, or DomainInfluence items with group_by=domain)

answers.description: Answers in the run (the influence denominator)

post.summary: Fetch the run's top sources now
post.description: Normally queued automatically when a harvest completes. Fetches the top FETCH_TOP_N sources politely (robots.txt, one request at a time per site) and stores the main text. Pages checked within FETCH_TTL_HOURS are skipped without a request; others are re-requested conditionally (ETag / Last-Modified), and text whose hash matches a stored copy is not stored again, so the standing audit only sees pages that actually changed. Results are in the run's `stats.fetch` and each source's `fetch_status`.

409.description: Run has not completed, or a fetch for it is already queued or running

get.summary: How each top source describes the brand
get.description: One row per top source in influence order. `stance` is null when there is no verdict; `audit_note` says why (owned, not readable, audit rejected or failed). `evidence_passage` is always text copied from the stored page: the LLM's quote is checked against the page and replaced with the page's own wording, and verdicts whose quote isn't on the page are rejected.

model.description: 'rule' when the brand was never named on the page

post.summary: Audit the run's fetched sources now
post.description: Normally queued automatically after the fetch. Pages already audited under the current prompt version are reused without calling the LLM.

409.description: Run has not completed, or an audit for it is already queued or running

get.summary: Ranked action list and headline numbers
get.description: Third-party sources with something to fix, ranked by leverage = influence x deficit, each with the fix (`action`) and the page's own words as evidence. The brand's own pages and pages that already describe it well are left out. `unaudited` lists top sources with no verdict (blocked, unreadable, rejected) by influence, so a large source that couldn't be read is still visible.

409.description: Run has not completed or has not been audited yet

get.summary: Co-citation graph of the top sources
get.description: Nodes are the top `limit` sources by influence. An edge joins two of them when they were cited in the same answer at least `min_together` times; `jaccard` is answers citing both / answers citing either.
